# Claspt

> Memory and encrypted credentials for AI agents, in a vault the user owns. A local, markdown-native vault (notes with AES-256-GCM secret blocks) that exposes memory and secrets to agents over MCP, a loopback HTTP API, a CLI and SDKs, behind named client tokens, approvals, a rate limit and an access log. Source-available under the PolyForm Shield License 1.0.0 (not open source).

Claspt runs as a desktop app (macOS, Windows, Linux) with a browser extension (Chrome family, Firefox) and a headless mode (`claspt serve`). Agents keep per-project memory (kinds, validity, staleness, search, review) and use credentials without seeing them (`claspt://secret` references, `claspt run`, browser "log me in", an SSH agent, passkeys).
